title.en: sunday upmarket in the truman brewery.
title.de: sunday upmarket in der truman brewery.

line.en: a market of vintage, fashion and homewares stalls, open 10:00 to 18:00 on sundays. a good late-morning walk from brick lane.
line.de: markt mit vintage-, mode- und wohnaccessoires-ständen, sonntags 10 bis 18 uhr offen. ein gutes ziel für den späten vormittag, zu fuß von der brick lane.
line.tr: vintage, moda ve ev dekorasyonu tezgahlarından oluşan bir pazar; pazar günleri 10:00 ile 18:00 arası açık. öğlene doğru brick lane'den yürümek iyi.

sparks.why: Sunday UpMarket, Truman Brewery, Brick Lane, listed for Sundays 10:00 to 18:00 by London & Partners and Visit London; the 15 Nov date itself was not checked on the venue site.
